# HandleDup

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

HandleDuplicate() that stores the new handle in `out`.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err HandleDup(Handle h, HandlePerms perms, Marker marker, Handle *out);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to duplicate. |
| `perms` | in | Permissions for the copy. |
| `marker` | in | [Marker](../types.md#marker) for the copy (own ports only). |
| `out` | out | Receives the new handle on success; may be NULL. |

## Returns

As HandleDuplicate().
